description: The Laya decision family (H5): decision_choose (a choice over the caller's options), decision_test (yes/no) and decision_score (an ordinal level) over the pinned multilingual Laya checkpoint (github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya, commit c73908d96ff73c0062c340a11bf7c54ec7d8bc4d, tag v0.4.6, Apache-2.0), running through the vendored laya-ts runtime. Every returned confidence is EXPLICITLY UNCALIBRATED (DEC-08): the upstream model card ships uncalibrated logits and a clamping warning, and this extension never presents them as calibrated probabilities.

tools.name: decision_choose
tools.description: Choose one of the caller's options for a stated prompt, over the pinned Laya checkpoint. Returns the chosen option, the per-option scores, and a confidence that is EXPLICITLY UNCALIBRATED (DEC-08) — the upstream model ships uncalibrated logits.

tools.name: decision_test
tools.description: Answer a stated yes/no question over the pinned Laya checkpoint. The confidence is EXPLICITLY UNCALIBRATED (DEC-08).

tools.name: decision_score
tools.description: Score a stated prompt onto one of the caller's ordinal levels over the pinned Laya checkpoint. The confidence is EXPLICITLY UNCALIBRATED (DEC-08).

telemetryContent: the vendored runtime performs no network access; the pinned artifacts load from the host-prepared local directory only
